name: Ti5robot T170A V2
summary: A 1.75 m, 58 kg bipedal research humanoid with 42-44 DOF, 7-DOF arms (1.5 kg each) and 6-DOF OYMotion dexterous hands, sold in standard batches for research, teaching and showrooms.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller or distributor found; Ti5robot lists only Shanghai sales contacts (sales@ti5robot.com).

specs.label: Total DOF
specs.conditions: depends on head version (1 or 3 DOF)

specs.label: Dexterous hand
specs.quote: 灵巧手型号 傲意灵巧手 灵巧手自由度 6 手部负载 3KG

specs.label: Compute
specs.quote: 控制和算力 Jeston AGX Orin 64G 开发者套件

capabilities.sdk: Web control system; secondary development documentation
notes: Unboxing checklist names dexterous hands, camera, six-axis force sensors, chassis and IMU as the robot's peripherals ('170A 的外设包括：灵巧手、相机、六维力、底盘、IMU').
Six-axis wrist force sensors and SR360 obstacle sensing are optional extras.
Maker lists research, teaching and showroom guiding as uses; the 1.5 kg arm payload limits physical work.

evidence.task: Robotics research (dual-arm control, gait, perception), university teaching and showroom guiding
evidence.note: No industrial or construction use reported.
